WITH grouped_scans AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval
),
matched_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(scan_count) AS total_scans
  FROM grouped_scans
)
SELECT
  g.site_code,
  g.risk_evaluation_status,
  g.average_compression_ratio,
  g.scan_count,
  g.scan_count::numeric / t.total_scans AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM grouped_scans AS g
CROSS JOIN matched_total AS t
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;
